cards.title: Lanterns on HBO
cards.text: A gritty, atmospheric detective mystery. It follows two interstellar lawmen uncovering a dark, earthly secret, blending high-stakes tension with deep character drama.

cards.title: Brown Sugar Oat-Milk Latte
cards.text: A rich, velvety espresso drink shaken over ice with brown sugar and cinnamon, then topped with creamy oat milk. It is pure coffee-shop comfort you can easily make at home.

cards.title: "Everywhere, Everything" by Noah Kahan feat. Gracie Abrams
cards.text: An evocative, folk pop track with raw emotion and reflective songwriting. Its warm, acoustic sound makes it THE soundtrack for early mornings and easy weekends
